run.head_commit_message:
refactor(sim): the march's sync as one crate pass (spec 39 step 8b5-xxxiii) (#664)

* refactor(sim): the march's sync as one crate pass (spec 39 step 8b5-xxxiii)

FormationMarch.sync_units makes one call, `march_sync` (march/sync.rs), over
every squad: each living unit's distance along the route, a router on its
point on the route, a loose one where its own moves took it, and the rest
placed on their places or walked a tick to where they make for, over the
bodies lying; a fall from a climb face lands its hurt onto the fell queue in
the crate. Its WALKED and SYNCED holds and FormationWalk.place_of are gone.
Outcomes don't change.

* refactor(sim): the scrum as one crate call (spec 39 step 8b5-xxxiv)

FormationScrum.step makes one call, scrum_step (scrum/step.rs): engaging,
readying, the stances, the manoeuvres, the seek, the regroup, the
withdrawal, the pursuit and the stall over one roster, their events in
the log in that order. It returns the pursuers back at their posts, whose
routes FormationPursuit.mirror sets. Each phase's class hands over its
rules; the per-phase bindings stay for their tests and tick_phases.
Outcomes don't change.

* refactor(sim): the whole tick as one crate pass (spec 39 step 8b5-xli) (#672)

`tick::step` runs the opening, the scrum, the aftermath, the mustering
and the end over one roster of every unit the squads hold, listing the
squads afresh between the passes as CrateRoster.of did (`relisted`: the
squads a join took in dropped, the factions coded again, each squad's
living read from its members), handing the mustering recovery's strays

arguments and returns each pass's flat result; the five bindings now

* refactor(sim): the whole tick as one crate call from GDScript (spec 39 step 8b5-xlii) (#673)

FormationSimulation.step makes one `tick_step` call (FormationTick) over a roster of every
unit the squads hold (CrateRoster.of(..., every)). Each pass's GDScript class hands its
arguments (`args`) and mirrors its part of the result (`mirror`) in the passes' order,
under CrateMirroring: while it is on, the writes from GDScript's copies into the crate
take the crate's value or are left out, so no mirror lands over what a later pass in the
call did. The events are decoded once. Outcomes don't change.
